kits.title: Quarry Foreman
kits.lore: Runs the old stone pits and settles disputes with a chain flail.

passive.name: Grit Under Nails
passive.text: Every third attack hits harder and mends a little health.

abilities.name: Rubble Sweep
abilities.text: Swings the flail in a full circle, hurting everyone nearby; clears waves quickly.

abilities.name: Shoulder Into It
abilities.text: Barges forward and slows the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Stand the Ground
abilities.text: Braces behind the flail for a shield that grows with bonus health.

abilities.name: Quarry Collapse
abilities.text: Slams the ground; a moment later a ring of stone throws enemies in the area into the air.

kits.title: Bog Warden
kits.lore: Keeps the drowned bells of the mere and rings them for whoever is lost.

passive.name: Sunken Bell
passive.text: After each ability their next attack rings out, hurting enemies around them.

abilities.name: Toll
abilities.text: Strikes an enemy with a bell-clap that hurts and slows.

abilities.name: Mire Tether
abilities.text: Ties a chain of bog-weed to an enemy; if it holds, the enemy is rooted.

abilities.name: Peat Hide
abilities.text: Takes less damage for a few seconds, as though wrapped in wet earth.

abilities.name: Drowning Chime
abilities.text: Charges ahead with the great bell; every enemy in the line is stunned.

kits.title: Pit Scavenger
kits.lore: A duelist who learned their trade picking over battlefields.

passive.name: Carrion Instinct
passive.text: Deals more damage to towers and to enemies with no ally nearby.

abilities.name: Gutting Hook
abilities.text: Flings a hooked knife in a line, hurting the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Scatter Step
abilities.text: Darts a short way and gains a burst of speed.

abilities.name: Picked Clean
abilities.text: A cruel cut that heals them for part of the damage.

abilities.name: Last One Standing
abilities.text: For a few seconds attacks faster and heals from their hits; a kill extends it.

kits.title: Chain Ranger
kits.lore: Hunts the reed beds with a weighted chain and the patience of a heron.

passive.name: Long Reach
passive.text: Attacks from near the end of their range deal extra damage.

abilities.name: Chainlash
abilities.text: Whips the chain in a line, hurting and slowing.

abilities.name: Snare Coil
abilities.text: Throws a loop of chain that roots the first enemy caught.

abilities.name: Recoil
abilities.text: Springs backwards and gains a small shield.

abilities.name: Drag Under
abilities.text: Hooks an enemy, hauls them close and stuns them briefly.

kits.title: Light Keeper
kits.lore: Kept the lighthouse for forty winters; now they keep their team.

passive.name: Salt-Cured
passive.text: Gains maximum health slowly over the game, up to a cap.

abilities.name: Anchor Swing
abilities.text: Swings their old anchor in an arc, hurting and slowing.

abilities.name: Beacon Pulse
abilities.text: Lights the beacon on their back: nearby enemies are drawn to attack them.

abilities.name: Kept Watch
abilities.text: Braces against the storm for a shield and extra armour.

abilities.name: Lighthouse Charge
abilities.text: Charges a long way to an area and knocks the enemies there into the air.

kits.title: Fen Swordsman
kits.lore: Lost their sight to marsh fever and trusts only the sound of the reeds.

passive.name: Listening Blade
passive.text: After a few seconds without being hit, their next attack is a sure critical.

abilities.name: Reed Cut
abilities.text: Dashes through an enemy, cutting as they pass.

abilities.name: Wading Sweep
abilities.text: Sweeps the shallows around them, hurting and slowing enemies.

abilities.name: Mire Guard
abilities.text: A shield that is larger for every enemy close to them.

abilities.name: Thousandth Stroke
abilities.text: Leaps to an enemy and strikes again and again; it hurts more the lower their health.

kits.title: Ice Ferryman
kits.lore: Poles the frozen channels and charges a toll no one wants to pay.

passive.name: Cold Wake
passive.text: Enemies hurt by their abilities are briefly slowed.

abilities.name: Pole Vault
abilities.text: Vaults to a spot and hurts enemies where they land.

abilities.name: Black Ice
abilities.text: Freezes the ground: enemies inside are slowed, then rooted.

abilities.name: Rime Coat
abilities.text: Coats themselves in frost for a shield.

abilities.name: Crossing Toll
abilities.text: Poles across to an area; after a short pause every enemy around them is stunned.

kits.title: Gravedigger
kits.lore: Digs the barrow-fields and never forgets who owes them a burial.

passive.name: Earthen Debt
passive.text: Each takedown permanently adds a little attack damage.

abilities.name: Spade Toss
abilities.text: Hurls the spade in a line; it hurts and slows the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Grave Rush
abilities.text: Dashes to an enemy and stuns them on arrival.

abilities.name: Turned Soil
abilities.text: Recovers health over a few seconds.

abilities.name: Unearthing
abilities.text: Throws an enemy into the air and buries them in heavy damage.

kits.title: Boar Hunter
kits.lore: Wears the tusks of the first boar they ever brought down.

passive.name: Rootsnout
passive.text: Deals more damage to monsters and towers.

abilities.name: Tusk Gore
abilities.text: Rams an enemy, hurting them and knocking them up.

abilities.name: Hide Bristle
abilities.text: Raises their bristles for a shield and hurts enemies around them.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.text: Stamps the ground, hurting everything nearby; good on camps and waves.

abilities.name: Tuskline Run
abilities.text: Charges a long way in a line, hurting and slowing all enemies they pass.

kits.title: Walking Menhir
kits.lore: A standing stone that woke when the island was young.

passive.name: Weathered
passive.text: Takes less damage while above half health.

abilities.name: Tumbling Slab
abilities.text: Tips a slab in a line that knocks the first enemy into the air.

abilities.name: Rooted Sentinel
abilities.text: Plants itself: nearby enemies are forced to attack it.

abilities.name: Slate Skin
abilities.text: Hardens for extra armour and resistance.

abilities.name: Standing Circle
abilities.text: Raises a ring of stones round an area; after a moment every enemy inside is stunned.

kits.title: Moth Trickster
kits.lore: Flits between lantern and lantern, laughing.

passive.name: Wingdust
passive.text: After a few seconds out of combat, fades from sight until they attack.

abilities.name: Flutter Strike
abilities.text: Darts to an enemy and strikes.

abilities.name: Pollen Haze
abilities.text: Bursts a cloud that hurts and slows enemies inside.

abilities.name: Moult
abilities.text: Sheds their wings and dashes away, untouchable for a moment.

abilities.name: Nightmoth Swarm
abilities.text: Sends a swarm at an enemy that bursts after a moment; finishes off weakened targets.

kits.title: Peat Cutter
kits.lore: Cuts the bog for fuel and has never once been cold.

passive.name: Harvest Rhythm
passive.text: Each enemy hit by their abilities heals them a little.

abilities.name: Wide Swathe
abilities.text: Sweeps the scythe in a wide arc; clears waves and camps.

abilities.name: Hook the Sheaf
abilities.text: Hooks an enemy, slowing them heavily.

abilities.name: Bale Guard
abilities.text: Raises a shield of bound straw.

abilities.name: Reaping Season
abilities.text: Spins for three seconds, hurting everything near them; attacks faster afterwards.

kits.title: Quill Archer
kits.lore: Grows their own arrows and is very particular about who gets them.

passive.name: Barbed
passive.text: Every third hit on the same enemy roots them for a moment.

abilities.name: Quill Volley
abilities.text: Looses a fan of quills, hurting enemies in front; clears waves.

abilities.name: Burrow
abilities.text: Dives into the ground and resurfaces a short way off.

abilities.name: Bristle Snare
abilities.text: Leaves a snare that roots the first enemy to step on it.

abilities.name: Hedgerow Storm
abilities.text: Fires a long line of quills, hurting and slowing all enemies in it.

kits.title: Hart Warden
kits.lore: Leads the herds of the high meadow and defends them with their crown.

passive.name: Herd Sense
passive.text: Allies near them gain a little armour.

abilities.name: Antler Rush
abilities.text: Rushes an enemy and gores them.

abilities.name: Bellow
abilities.text: Roars: enemies around are slowed, allies around move faster.

abilities.name: Spring Leap
abilities.text: Leaps to an ally and shields them both.

abilities.name: Stag Guard
abilities.text: Plants their crown: allies nearby gain a large shield and enemies are thrown back.

kits.title: Chimney Crow
kits.lore: Nests in the smokestacks of the old forges and strikes from the soot.

passive.name: Ash Brand
passive.text: Their abilities brand an enemy; their next attack on a branded enemy burns for extra damage.

abilities.name: Cinder Feather
abilities.text: Throws a burning feather in a line.

abilities.name: Flue Dive
abilities.text: Blinks a short distance through the smoke.

abilities.name: Sootcloak
abilities.text: Vanishes in smoke for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Chimney Fall
abilities.text: Drops on an enemy from above; heavy damage that finishes off weakened targets.

kits.title: Mere Dancer
kits.lore: Dances the eel-blades across the lake at night; few see the dance and walk away.

passive.name: Slick
passive.text: After a dash their next attack deals extra damage.

abilities.name: Eelcoil Lash
abilities.text: Spins the blades around them, hurting everyone near; clears waves.

abilities.name: Eelslip Dash
abilities.text: Slips through enemies in a line, hurting them.

abilities.name: Brackish Veil
abilities.text: A thin veil of water blocks the next enemy ability.

abilities.name: Tide Severance
abilities.text: Becomes a rush of water down a line, cutting every enemy in it; finishes off the weakened.

kits.title: Willow Singer
kits.lore: Sings to the will-o'-lights and they sing back.

passive.name: Lilt
passive.text: Each ability they land shortens their other cooldowns a little.

abilities.name: Wisp Arc
abilities.text: Sends a wisp in a long arc that hurts the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Hush Ring
abilities.text: A ring of silence: enemies inside cannot cast for a moment.

abilities.name: Drift
abilities.text: Floats away faster with a small shield.

abilities.name: Willow Chorus
abilities.text: After a short song, a wide area of light hurts every enemy in it; clears waves.

kits.title: Kiln Mage
kits.lore: Fired pots for the hill villages until the kiln began to answer.

passive.name: Fired Clay
passive.text: Each ability they cast hardens their skin with a small shield.

abilities.name: Firebrick
abilities.text: Throws a glowing brick in a line.

abilities.name: Slag Pool
abilities.text: Pours molten slag: enemies in it are burned and slowed; clears waves.

abilities.name: Kiln Door
abilities.text: Steps back through a door of heat, leaving the ground behind them burning.

abilities.name: Furnace Breath
abilities.text: Breathes a long cone of fire for heavy damage.

kits.title: Lamp Snuffer
kits.lore: Walks the streets at dusk putting out the lamps, and anyone else.

passive.name: Snuffed
passive.text: Deals extra damage to enemies below a third of their health.

abilities.name: Wick Snip
abilities.text: Dashes to an enemy and cuts.

abilities.name: Gloomstep
abilities.text: Fades from sight for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Ash Ward
abilities.text: Blocks the next enemy ability.

abilities.name: Lights Out
abilities.text: Darkens an area: enemies inside are silenced and hurt; finishes the weakened.

kits.title: Tidepool Sorceress
kits.lore: Reads the rock pools at low water and knows what the sea intends.

passive.name: Rockpool
passive.text: Allies near them slowly regain health.

abilities.name: Brine Burst
abilities.text: Bursts a ball of brine in an area; clears waves.

abilities.name: Kelp Snare
abilities.text: Wraps an enemy in kelp, rooting them.

abilities.name: Tidecup
abilities.text: Shields an ally with a cup of seawater.

abilities.name: Rising Pool
abilities.text: Floods an area: allies inside are shielded, enemies inside are slowed and hurt.

kits.title: Star Cartographer
kits.lore: Draws the maps by night and plots a course straight through their enemies.

passive.name: Plotted Course
passive.text: Moves faster toward an enemy they have marked.

abilities.name: Compass Needle
abilities.text: Throws a needle in a long line that hurts and marks the first enemy.

abilities.name: Meridian Bind
abilities.text: Roots a marked enemy where they stand.

abilities.name: Waypoint
abilities.text: Blinks to a point they have charted.

abilities.name: Fixed Star
abilities.text: Calls down a star on a distant enemy: heavy damage and a stun.

kits.title: Mosaic Glazier
kits.lore: Builds windows from broken glass, and the light comes out sharper.

passive.name: Tesserae
passive.text: Each ability adds a tile; with every tile their abilities hit harder.

abilities.name: Shard Fan
abilities.text: Throws a fan of glass shards in front of them; clears waves.

abilities.name: Leaded Pane
abilities.text: Raises a pane of glass that slows enemies who cross it.

abilities.name: Refract
abilities.text: Bends the next enemy ability away.

abilities.name: Rose Window
abilities.text: A great round window of light forms over an area; enemies inside are stunned and hurt.

kits.title: Lantern Spirit
kits.lore: The spirit of a ship's lantern that never went out.

passive.name: Kept Flame
passive.text: When badly hurt, gains a shield (once a minute).

abilities.name: Moth Light
abilities.text: Sends a light in a line that hurts and slows.

abilities.name: Lantern Leash
abilities.text: Leashes an enemy to the lantern; if they stay close, they are rooted.

abilities.name: Flicker
abilities.text: Flickers out and reappears a short way off.

abilities.name: Shuttered Glow
abilities.text: Opens the lantern wide: every enemy around is stunned.

kits.title: Ember Apprentice
kits.lore: Burns most of what they touch and is learning to choose.

passive.name: Cinderdrift
passive.text: Their attacks splash sparks on nearby minions.

abilities.name: Ember Toss
abilities.text: Tosses an ember that hurts an enemy from a distance.

abilities.name: Smoulder
abilities.text: Sets the ground smouldering, hurting enemies over time; clears waves.

abilities.name: Bellows Kick
abilities.text: Blasts a nearby enemy back with a gust.

abilities.name: Wildfire Seed
abilities.text: Plants a seed of fire that bursts over a wide area.

kits.title: Harpoon Gunner
kits.lore: Hunted the whales of the grey sea; now they hunt in lanes.

passive.name: Steady Aim
passive.text: Standing still raises their critical chance.

abilities.name: Harpoon Shot
abilities.text: Fires a harpoon in a line that hurts and slows.

abilities.name: Chain Volley
abilities.text: Sprays shot over an area; clears waves.

abilities.name: Kick Back
abilities.text: Fires and leaps backward.

abilities.name: Whaler's Mark
abilities.text: A long, slow shot that hits the first enemy for heavy damage.

kits.title: Shepherd Slinger
kits.lore: Kept a hillside flock and never lost a sheep to wolves.

passive.name: Shepherd's Count
passive.text: Every fourth attack heals them a little.

abilities.name: Sling Stone
abilities.text: Slings a stone that hurts and slows an enemy.

abilities.name: Crook Pull
abilities.text: Hooks an ally out of danger and shields them.

abilities.name: Hedge Hop
abilities.text: Hops a short way.

abilities.name: Flock Volley
abilities.text: Rains stones over an area.

kits.title: Belfry Marksman
kits.lore: Rings the hours from the old tower, each one precisely.

passive.name: Resonance
passive.text: Every third attack rings on to a second enemy.

abilities.name: Peal
abilities.text: A ringing shot in a line.

abilities.name: Muffle
abilities.text: Silences an enemy for a moment.

abilities.name: Tolling Step
abilities.text: Steps aside and shields themselves and a nearby ally.

abilities.name: Carillon
abilities.text: Rings a peal of bells over an area for heavy damage.

kits.title: Dock Brawler
kits.lore: Loads cargo by day and settles debts with a crossbow by night.

passive.name: Ratchet
passive.text: Attacks the same enemy faster with each hit.

abilities.name: Bolt Burst
abilities.text: Fires a spread of bolts in front.

abilities.name: Dockhook
abilities.text: Swings on a hook to a nearby spot.

abilities.name: Tarpaulin
abilities.text: Throws a tarp over themselves or an ally for a shield.

abilities.name: Broadside
abilities.text: Fires everything at once down a line.

kits.title: Mortar Mason
kits.lore: Lays bricks in peacetime; in war they lay them on people.

passive.name: Mortar Splash
passive.text: Attacks splash a little and deal extra damage to towers.

abilities.name: Lob
abilities.text: Lobs a shell into an area.

abilities.name: Scaffold
abilities.text: Jumps up and over to a nearby spot.

abilities.name: Brick Cover
abilities.text: Puts up a low wall for a shield.

abilities.name: Demolition
abilities.text: Shells a long strip of ground for heavy damage.

kits.title: Dove Magus
kits.lore: Fires a wand-gun charged with feathers and old blessings.

passive.name: Feathered Shot
passive.text: Hitting an enemy gives a short burst of speed.

abilities.name: Quill Ray
abilities.text: A beam of light in a line.

abilities.name: Coo
abilities.text: A soft call slows enemies in an area.

abilities.name: Wing Step
abilities.text: Steps on the wind a short way.

abilities.name: Flight of Doves
abilities.text: Releases a flight of glowing doves over an area.

kits.title: Steam Gunner
kits.lore: Built their own boiler-rifle and only sometimes scalds themselves.

passive.name: Pressure
passive.text: Abilities build pressure; at full pressure their next attack stuns.

abilities.name: Steam Jet
abilities.text: A scalding jet in a line.

abilities.name: Scald Trap
abilities.text: Sets a trap that roots the first enemy to trip it.

abilities.name: Vent
abilities.text: Vents steam to dash, slowing enemies behind.

abilities.name: Boiling Point
abilities.text: Overloads the boiler on one enemy: heavy damage and a stun.

kits.title: Hedge Archer
kits.lore: Quick as a sparrow and twice as cheeky.

passive.name: Flitting
passive.text: After a dash they attack faster for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Pinfeather Arrow
abilities.text: A swift arrow in a line.

abilities.name: Scatter Shot
abilities.text: Looses a scatter of arrows in front; clears waves.

abilities.name: Hop
abilities.text: Hops a short way.

abilities.name: Daybreak Flurry
abilities.text: A rapid barrage over an area.

kits.title: Dial Priestess
kits.lore: Tends the great sundial and its slow, warm shadow.

passive.name: Noon Mark
passive.text: Their heals are stronger on badly hurt allies.

abilities.name: Gnomon Ray
abilities.text: A ray of light in a line that hurts and slows.

abilities.name: Warm Hands
abilities.text: Heals an ally.

abilities.name: Shade Shift
abilities.text: Shields an ally in a cool shadow.

abilities.name: Solstice Halo
abilities.text: A halo of light over an area heals every ally inside.

kits.title: Shell Knight
kits.lore: A hermit crab who found a helmet and never gave it back.

passive.name: Shell Guard
passive.text: When first hit after a rest, gains a shield.

abilities.name: Claw Snap
abilities.text: Snaps at an enemy, hurting and slowing them.

abilities.name: Pincer Grip
abilities.text: Grips an enemy in their claw and holds them still.

abilities.name: Shell Up
abilities.text: Pulls into their shell, taking much less damage.

abilities.name: Sidelong Surge
abilities.text: Rushes sideways down a line like a breaking wave, throwing up every enemy in it.

kits.title: Root Witch
kits.lore: Lives in a hollow willow and knows every root on the island.

passive.name: Tangled
passive.text: Roots last longer on slowed enemies.

abilities.name: Root Lance
abilities.text: Sends a root along the ground that roots the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Wick Burn
abilities.text: Burns an enemy from a distance.

abilities.name: Twine
abilities.text: Twines a vine to an ally, shielding them.

abilities.name: Thicket Snare
abilities.text: Thick roots burst from an area, rooting every enemy in it.

kits.title: Alder Healer
kits.lore: An alder tree that walked down to the river to help.

passive.name: Sap
passive.text: Healing they give leaves a small shield.

abilities.name: Catkin Burst
abilities.text: Bursts catkins in an area, hurting enemies and healing allies; clears waves.

abilities.name: Bark Ward
abilities.text: Shields an ally with bark.

abilities.name: Root Mend
abilities.text: Heals an ally over a few seconds.

abilities.name: Grove Rising
abilities.text: Raises a grove: allies inside heal, enemies inside are slowed.

kits.title: Raven Shield
kits.lore: Carries a shield painted with the eye of a raven that never blinks.

passive.name: Raven's Eye
passive.text: Their first hit on an enemy marks them; allies deal extra damage to the marked.

abilities.name: Wingbeat
abilities.text: Leaps at an enemy, knocking them up.

abilities.name: Caw
abilities.text: A harsh cry: nearby enemies are forced to turn on them.

abilities.name: Feather Mantle
abilities.text: Shields themselves and an ally.

abilities.name: Black Pinions
abilities.text: Dives from above into an area, stunning every enemy there.

kits.title: Mill Binder
kits.lore: Built the windmills on the ridge and taught them to fight.

passive.name: Vane Wake
passive.text: Their dashes leave a gust that slows enemies.

abilities.name: Sail Slash
abilities.text: Cuts a line with a sail-blade.

abilities.name: Millstone Bind
abilities.text: Drops a millstone on an enemy, rooting them.

abilities.name: Draft
abilities.text: Rides a draft of wind a short way.

abilities.name: Whirling Vane
abilities.text: A whirlwind draws enemies in an area together and stuns them.

kits.title: Window Spirit
kits.lore: The light that falls through the chapel window, given a will.

passive.name: Dappled
passive.text: Their heals leave a small shield behind.

abilities.name: Prism Bolt
abilities.text: A bolt of split light hurts an enemy; clears waves.

abilities.name: Lumen
abilities.text: Heals an ally.

abilities.name: Glasswall
abilities.text: Shields an ally behind coloured glass.

abilities.name: Clerestory
abilities.text: Floods a wide area with light, healing every ally inside.

kits.title: Fen Elder
kits.lore: A very old frog who has been right about everything for a very long time.

passive.name: Croak
passive.text: Every third ability also slows the enemies it hits.

abilities.name: Lily Lob
abilities.text: Lobs a lily pad that bursts in an area, hurting and slowing; clears waves.

abilities.name: Bog Bind
abilities.text: Binds an enemy in bog-weed, rooting them.

abilities.name: Leap Frog
abilities.text: Leaps a short way.

abilities.name: Fen Fog
abilities.text: A thick fog over an area: enemies inside are silenced and slowed.
